about: Pinned values for Eym's world (tools/world-checks.mjs). 'fixed' are invariants no tool changes: the owner's maps. 'managed' follow the world: a rebuild that moves one reports it, and node tools/world.mjs --accept-pins records the new value with a note.

dataBudget.note: The shipped data files as they were before the land grew (commit 306c3a7, 19 November 2026), in bytes. No file may pass `factor` times its size here, nor all of them together `factor` times their sum (2,824,693).

fixed.tectonicsNote: Recorded anew on 20 November 2026 (canon: Caren in the plate record). The plates, their poles, speeds and boundaries, the continents, the rasters and the mantle are what they were; the history's entry for Caren, Caren's own record, the arc volcanoes of the Caren Plate's far edges and the name of two plates' speed rule changed. Recorded again the same day for the plume under the islands west of Caren (one volcano, its ridge of seamounts and one line of the history added; nothing else).

registryCsvSha256.note: Rivers carry the climate: the rivers' monthly rain is the budget's, the drainage measures each channel's and each drawn river's runoff
